name: untriangle-v3
why: A Fusion 360 recreation held to the export's own numbers: three quarter-twisted bars closed into a triangle, rebuilt as ruled lofts plus corner prisms. The export's B-rep measures 24799.94 mm3 exactly (BRepGProp); the clean parametric construction is 24800.00 exactly, +0.00024%, and every one of the twelve twisted walls is the bilinear patch through the same four corners as Fusion's, matched to 1.2e-4 mm — the export's own vertex scatter. The numbers recorded here are the runner's mesh-measured ones; their 1.7 mm3 gap to the exact volume is tessellation chord error on the saddle walls. The export carries one of the document's two bodies (Body12); this is that body. The bed contact picks up saddle-wall triangles lying within the mesh's resolution of the flat end, so its area is held to 2% and its patch count is the triangulation's: two once vendor patch 0005 splits the bars' rulings, on x86_64 and arm64 alike.
